newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow late Friday. Few sales of slaughter steers and heifers closed steady to firm.

Inquiry and demand were moderate. Sales confirmed on 500 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers. Last week's confirmed sales 105,200 head including 12,500 head or about 12 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - few select and choice 2-3 1050-1175 lbs 67.50-68.00, mostly 68.00.
Heifers - few select and choice 2-3 1050-1065 lbs 68.00; few mixed commercial to choice 1150 lbs heifers and heiferettes 66.00, few 1175 lbs including cows 65.00.
confirmed: 1000 last week: none last year: 500
